RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-female panel is common in education and does not demonstrate bias on its own. Raising the panel's gender composition will appear speculative and combative, which can damage your professional reputation.

While your leadership credentials appear stronger on paper, principal appointments heavily weigh interview performance, references, interpersonal fit, and school-specific priorities. While unconscious bias can never be ruled out entirely, there is currently no evidence that sex played a role.

Instead, send a polite reminder regarding your request for the written explanation. If you seek further feedback or consider challenging the decision, focus solely on objective qualifications, administrative experience, and appointment criteria rather than the demographic makeup of the selection committee.
